newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria sells 150,000 tonnes of wheat to Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Syria sells 150,000 tonnes of wheat to Algeria.

text.p: Syria's general establishment for cereal processing and trade (GECPT) has sold Algeria 150,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for delivery in April/May, a GECPT official said on Tuesday.
He said the wheat was sold recently through direct negotiations between officials of the state-owned grains bodies of Syria and Algeria.
He did not disclose the exact price but traders say contracts between government bodies of both states get special treatment.
Traders said the amount sold was separate from Algeria's tender last week to buy 75,000 tonnes of wheat which was re-launched on Tuesday.
Syria is already in the market to sell 50,000 tonnes of wheat for delivery in May. The tender set March 25 as final date to receive bids and the results would be confirmed on March 26.
